items.stem: What is the primary purpose of the Blueprint Consultation?

options.text: Guarantee a financial return before discovery.
Provide a free production deployment to every interested prospect.
Replace qualification with a long product demonstration.
Connect prioritized workflows and measurable value to a sponsored investment and validation decision.

items.stem: Which sequence best represents the Blueprint customer conversations?

options.text: Visioning, DITL interviews, Executive Validation.
Architecture certification, agent build, renewal.
Pilot approval, general product training, procurement.
Executive Validation, pilot deployment, Visioning.

items.stem: Which statement is a business outcome rather than merely an activity?

options.text: Reduce support handling cost while maintaining resolution quality.
Create ten agent ideas.
Connect one more repository regardless of use.
Hold three AI brainstorming meetings.

items.stem: A partner has strong industry knowledge. What is the best use of it in Blueprint?

options.text: Translate customer goals into grounded workflow discovery and an agreed services roadmap.
Bypass the Glean account team on pilot approvals.
Treat every discovery finding as signed delivery scope.
Promise unsupported features to differentiate the proposal.

items.stem: How does Sales Blueprinting differ from a post-sales implementation blueprint?

options.text: It is simply another name for a connector configuration guide.
It replaces all architecture review and security work.
It is only a technical diagram with no business owner.
It centers on outcomes, discovery, value and the evaluation decision.
A customer logo and an internal benchmark.
A list of product features with no workflow context.
A polished demo and an unexplained savings headline.
Priorities, owners, workflow evidence, labeled value, success criteria and next decisions.

items.stem: A sponsor asks whether Blueprint guarantees a pilot. What should you say?

options.text: No; it helps agree the lightest sufficient validation, with pilots justified and separately gated.
Yes; all customers must run a pilot after Visioning.
No validation can happen until a full production contract is signed.
Yes; completion automatically creates a pilot entitlement.

items.stem: A learner sees AISBS in this workbook. What is its status?

options.text: A replacement for all technical certifications.
A proposed credential name and design requiring program-owner confirmation.
An already approved global Glean certification policy.
A promise that Impartner has already published the course.
